assets.name: Goatminster
assets.canonicalSummary: High pasture village whose elected goat judge settles grazing disputes beneath a painted canopy. Present pressure: Prize animals vanish and return wearing unfamiliar bells.

proposedPlaceDetails.name: Painted Canopy
proposedPlaceDetails.description: A small green-and-ochre shelter over the grazing court, where the elected judge hears neighbours' pasture disputes.

proposedPlaceDetails.name: Bellwright's Shed
proposedPlaceDetails.description: A repair shed for collars, buckles and herd bells. Its keeper can compare an unfamiliar bell with local patterns.

proposedPlaceDetails.name: Grazing Common
proposedPlaceDetails.description: Shared high pasture divided by old stone boundaries; grazing turns are discussed in the village court.

proposedPlaceDetails.name: High Pens
proposedPlaceDetails.description: Sheltered sorting pens where herders check their animals before taking them onto the higher slopes.

proposedPlaceDetails.name: Cheese Court
proposedPlaceDetails.description: A dairy yard shared by nearby households, with covered worktables and shelves of young cheeses.

proposedPlaceDetails.name: Packhorse Yard
proposedPlaceDetails.description: A small approach-side yard for unloading salt, grain and repair materials without blocking the village lanes.

proposedPlaceDetails.name: Lower Spring

assets.name: Whitewindow
assets.canonicalSummary: Location: Northern stone hills reached by a branch road from the Chalklands. Livelihood: Metal fittings, stonework, repair contracts, and upland husbandry. Pale mineral seams give the outer cliff the appearance of narrow lit windows. Most trade takes place in a rebuilt guest hall with a very old floor. Interior neighbourhoods are homes, not an invitation to explore ancestral rooms. The hold imports food in good years as well as bad and regards reliable contracts as part of its winter defences.

proposedPlaceDetails.name: Guest Hall
proposedPlaceDetails.description: The rebuilt public hall where visiting traders meet residents, using an old stone floor retained through later repairs.

proposedPlaceDetails.name: Fittings Yard
proposedPlaceDetails.description: An open workshop court for hinges, braces and cart fittings; finished pieces are checked beside the repair benches.

proposedPlaceDetails.name: Winter Stores
proposedPlaceDetails.description: Raised, ventilated stores for imported grain and preserved food, with space to unload pack animals under cover.

proposedPlaceDetails.name: Stonecutters' Steps
proposedPlaceDetails.description: A stair route linking the dressed-stone terraces and work yards. Hand-carried loads use the steps while carts follow the switchbacks.

proposedPlaceDetails.name: Contract Court
proposedPlaceDetails.description: A public meeting court where deliveries and repair work can be inspected before contracts are settled.

proposedPlaceDetails.name: High Fold
proposedPlaceDetails.description: A sheltered upper grazing enclosure that keeps livestock close during poor weather.

proposedPlaceDetails.name: Spring Cistern
proposedPlaceDetails.description: A small maintained cistern supplying the outer settlement; its approach is kept clear of stone dust and workshop waste.

assets.name: Copperdeep

proposedPlaceDetails.name: Upper Workings
proposedPlaceDetails.description: Timbered upper portals open onto a shared loading terrace where shifts gather and ore carts emerge.

proposedPlaceDetails.name: Ore Weighbridge
proposedPlaceDetails.description: A roofed tally station and stout weighing platform record each cart before it descends toward the furnaces.

proposedPlaceDetails.name: Cinder Court
proposedPlaceDetails.description: Smelting sheds surround a practical yard of fuel stacks, cooled slag and room for laden carts.

proposedPlaceDetails.name: Workers' Hall
proposedPlaceDetails.description: A communal hall offers shift notices, warm meals and space to settle disagreements away from the mine mouths.

proposedPlaceDetails.name: Washhouse Steps
proposedPlaceDetails.description: Broad worn steps link the terraces to public washing rooms and open stone bathing courts.

proposedPlaceDetails.name: Lantern Chapel
proposedPlaceDetails.description: A modest chapel beside the lower stairs keeps a sheltered place for miners' observances and families' vigils.

proposedPlaceDetails.name: Sealed Lower Gates

proposedPlaceDetails.name: West Caravan Yard
proposedPlaceDetails.description: A broad arrival court gives wagons space to unload, turn and wait for news of the crossing.

proposedPlaceDetails.name: Covered Market
proposedPlaceDetails.description: Connected roofed stalls keep provisions and repair goods within reach of travellers during foul weather.

proposedPlaceDetails.name: Rescue Hall
proposedPlaceDetails.description: A communal rescue base stores sleds, ropes and dry blankets beside a yard large enough for returning teams.

proposedPlaceDetails.name: Snowwall Gate

proposedPlaceDetails.name: East Road
proposedPlaceDetails.description: A winding wagon route follows the protected bends toward the mountain crossing and its higher weather.

proposedPlaceDetails.name: Bell Shelter
proposedPlaceDetails.description: A small roofed refuge by the last visible bend offers cover and a bell for signalling toward the gate.
